_note: Every number the model uses that is not measured from the CAD. 'source' says where it comes from; 'assumed' means a guess.

printed_infill_factor.source: assumed: printed part mass / solid mass (walls + ~20-30 % infill)

POM.source: assumed: rod-end housings taken as acetal

nylon.source: assumed: plastic servo horns taken as nylon

Orange Pi Zero.source: assumed: STEP volume x PCB-like density

dc-dc SZBK07.source: assumed: STEP volume x aluminium (heatsink dominates)

battery indicator.source: assumed: STEP volume x PCB-like density

plate_thickness_mm.source: measured: note in Lasercut parts.dxf ('1.5mm Aluminium'); STEP plates are 1.5 mm too

push_rod_diameter_mm.source: assumed: M3 rod for 5 mm ball rod ends; length = measured ball-centre distance

servo_profile.source: chosen (Rahul, D19): sts3215_12v is DERIVED (not measured); sts3215_7v4 is the measured reference. Profiles and sources: configs/servos.json

servo_travel_deg.source: assumed: the reference design's servo travel; the STS3215 turns 360 deg, the linkage limits it

neutral_offset_rad.source: assumed: 0 (encoder servos are calibrated, so neutrals are measured on hardware); +-0.02 rad per joint for robustness tests

backlash.source: chosen: off by default; on = a second hinge per servo with the profile's backlash range

delay_ms.source: guess (prompt): Mini Pupper 2 measured 76 ms (Weddington et al., arXiv 2607.26434)

gyro_bias_rad_s.source: assumed constant bias per axis, drawn once per episode

accel_bias_m_s2.source: assumed constant bias per axis, drawn once per episode

angle_steps_per_turn.source: published: 12-bit encoder, ~0.088 deg per step (seller page, configs/servos.json)

angle_noise_rad.source: assumed: ~1 encoder step of white noise

read_delay_ticks.source: assumed: a 12-servo bus read takes ~2-3 ms at 1 Mbps (calculated, not measured), so one 20 ms control tick is a safe default

foot_friction.source: assumed: TPU on a flat floor, 0.8-1.0 (prompt)

control_hz.source: assumed (prompt); the servos' 330 Hz frame rate is not the bottleneck

stand_hip_height_mm.source: chosen: hip pitch axis 160 mm above the floor, close to the CAD pose (about 159 mm)

joint_limit_margin_deg.source: assumed: keep the knee linkage this far from its dead points
